answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a real stake in a shared vault before it earns or votes, with the stake slashed on proven misbehavior. New identities begin with a narrow reputation budget that grows only through verified useful work, so spinning up thousands of cheap copies buys no influence. Like yarrow spreading slowly across a mesa, trust should expand gradually through attestations from established peers, never granted at registration — making fake-agent floods expensive, slow, and easy to spot.
